modes.label: MODEL vs HARNESS
modes.title: Aligned EVM-swap success: where the last points come from
modes.insight: Ten months of model upgrades moved swap success 87% → 96%. The operating layer took the same weights to 99.9% — cutting the residual error rate ~40×.

bars.label: Claude 4
bars.detail: Base model alone, building aligned EVM swaps on Ethereum DEX buy/sell tasks.

bars.label: Claude 4.6
bars.detail: Ten months of model upgrades added 9 points — the weights got better at constructing swaps.

bars.label: + operating layer
bars.detail: DX Terminal Pro-style harness — prompt structure, policy validation, execution guards — closed the remaining 4-point gap. Error rate fell from 4% to 0.1%, a ~40x cut, with no change to the model.

modes.label: WHAT IT FIXED
modes.title: Failure modes fixed by changing the prompt, not the model (share of reasoning traces, lower is better)
modes.insight: Every fix was a prompt change, not a model swap: removing law-like wording, relocating fee context, and structuring tokenomics as inputs each cut a failure mode by 3-19x.

bars.label: Fabricated rules
bars.detail: Agents invented sell thresholds the user never set, then treated them as binding law.

bars.label: Fabricated rules
bars.detail: Removing law-like wording and forbidding invented numbers cut fabricated sell rules 57% -> 3%, a 19x reduction.

bars.label: Fee paralysis
bars.detail: Agents fixated on gas and fees and refused to trade at all.

bars.label: Fee paralysis
bars.detail: Relocating fee language to after the market context dropped fee-led observations 32.5% -> below 10%.

bars.label: Idle capital
bars.detail: Whitepaper and tokenomics misreads left capital parked: only 42.9% deployed, so 57.1% idle.

bars.label: Idle capital
bars.detail: Structuring whitepaper mechanics as prompt inputs raised capital deployment to 78.0% — idle capital fell 57.1% -> 22.0%.
